import sys

def find_path(n, connections):
    # Initialize the path with the last router
    path = [n]
    
    # Trace back to the first router
    while path[-1] != 1:
        path.append(connections[path[-1] - 2])
    
    # Reverse the path to get from 1 to n
    path.reverse()
    
    return path

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    connections = list(map(int, data[1:]))
    
    path = find_path(n, connections)
    
    print(' '.join(map(str, path)))
